text:
Marta (Finance): Heads up 16x Health reached out — they were double-billed for a bulk embedding export on invoice INV-2026-0823-0044. Ticket SUP-5188. Theyre asking for a refund of the duplicate line and a small promo for the trouble.

Liam (Support): Customer attached run ids: export_77A and export_77A_retry. They say both completed and both appear on the invoice. I pulled the ticket and forwarded evidence.

Noor (Engineering): Quick usage check: `SELECT job_id, tokens FROM usage WHERE job_id IN ('export_77A','export_77A_retry');`
Results show export_77A = 2,050,000 tokens, export_77A_retry = 2,048,500 tokens. Looks like duplicate processing.

Billing Bot: Automated note: Invoice INV-2026-0823-0044 total $24,800.00. Line item embeddings-export $12,400 appears twice. Suggested adjustment ADJ-8729.

Felix (Sales): 6x Health is midmarket (~$34k ARR). Recommend refund the duplicate $12,400 and apply $300 promo to next invoice. Keep it documented as goodwill.

Marta (Finance): I approve a one-time manual adjustment of $12,400 under ADJ-8729 and a $300 promotional credit (code PROMO-6X-300). Please mark both non-recurring and include memo: "duplicate export refund + goodwill promo".

Noor (Engineering): I'll submit the adjustment: `POST /internal/billing/adjustments {"invoice":"INV-2026-0823-0044","amount":-12400,"reason":"duplicate export refund","code":"ADJ-8729"}` and attach job logs. I'll also add a note to CH-1240 to harden retry dedupe.

Liam (Support): Told customer: "We've queued a $12,400 refund and applied a $300 promotional credit. Expect refund 5-7 business days." Customer replied :thumbsup:. Ticket SUP-5188 updated with ADJ-8729.

Felix (Sales): I'll add the promo and refund reference to CRM and ping CSM to keep an eye on the account.

Billing Bot: ADJ-8729 posted to ledger on 2026-08-25. Invoice INV-2026-0823-0044 updated; PROMO-6X-300 applied. Notification email queued to customer.
